body:
maria: Hey @kevin @jamal — I pushed an update to PR #3124 that addresses the comments from yesterday. PTAL when you have a moment.

Changes: small lint fixes, tightened retry backoff from 2x -> 1.5x, added a unit test for the edge case, and updated the docs snippet. I left a short note in the PR about why I chose 1.5x.

Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/server/pull/3124

kevin: Thanks — quick q: the test change adds a sleep(20ms) to simulate jitter. Could that flake on CI containers with high load?

maria: Good call. I made it `sleep(20ms)` behind a deterministic fake clock in the test so it shouldn't flake. See the test file `runtime/retry/retry_test.go` — I added a comment.

jamal: Looked through the diff. LGTM overall. One nit: can we squash the lint commits into the test commit before merge? Easier to bisect later.

maria: Yep, I can squash — will do a quick rebase + force-push.

deploy-bot: CI status: build passed ✅, unit tests passed ✅, integration tests running (2/5).

kevin: If integration tests pass, I can approve. Also do we want to hold the canary later today or queue for tomorrow morning?

maria: My preference is tonight at 9pm PT (low traffic), but if anyone prefers morning we can do 9am PT. I can trigger the canary once integration is green and both approvals are in.

jamal: I prefer morning (9am PT) — easier to handle fallout. If it's urgent, fine tonight.

kevin: Morning works for me too. I'll give a stamp after CI finishes.

deploy-bot: Integration tests: 5/5 passed ✅.

maria: Great — squashed the lint commit as requested and pushed. Force-pushed the branch.

kevin: Approved. :+1:

jamal: Approved pending the usual smoke on canary. Good work.

maria: Thanks both — scheduling canary for 9am PT tomorrow and will post updates in #eng-oncall. If anything blocks, ping me here or DM.

kevin: Thanks — leaving a short note in the PR about rollback steps for oncall.

jamal: Nice. :rocket:

maria: Done — PR merged after canary succeeded. (closing thread)
